text:
alex.marketing: Quick preflight for "Superday" release — T-minus 48h. Need final changelog link, canonical docs URL, webinar slot confirmation, and how inbound leads will be routed. Who can confirm each piece?

jamie.eng: I can take the changelog. PR is open, waiting on one review. Will merge in ~90m and post the permalinks.

priya.prod: Webinar slot looks good on our side — Tues 10AM PT (60m). Zoe, you good to lead the narrative?

zoe.content: Yup. Draft deck mostly done, will push latest to Google Slides by EOD. Will include benchmark callouts + 2 customer quotes.

jamie.eng: Changelog merged ✅. Public permalink: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/ab12f7d9. It's the condensed list we agreed on (features, breaking notes, rollout plan).

alex.marketing: Perfect — drop that into the release doc and marketing post. Can someone paste the canonical docs link (not the staging one)?

liam.ops: Canonical docs: https://docs.redwood.inference.com/release/superday-2026. note: prod CDN purge is scheduled at 09:50 PT on release morning.

priya.prod: Inbound routing — we need two lead buckets: (1) enterprise interest (AE team), (2) trials & self-serve. Propose a form param ?source=superday and then funnel in SFDC. Liam — can you add UTM + form mapping?

liam.ops: Yup. We'll use utm_campaign=superday2026 + form param source=superday. I'll add mapping to the zap that creates SFDC leads. Test in staging now.

zoe.content: Messaging iteration: short lead headline, bench stat (70% latency reduction for embedding batch), and CTA to sign up for the webinar or start free trial. Drafts in /drive/Marketing/Superday.

alex.marketing: Jamie — can you add a short technical blurb for the post about canary and fallback? Ops needs the exact rollout window for the post.

jamie.eng: Canary plan: 10% traffic on launch day, 50% by +6h, full by +24h if no regressions. Rollback triggers: error rate >3% or 2x latency baseline. Deploy command (for ops reference):

```bash
./deploy --env prod --canary 0.1 --monitor 24h --rollback-on error_rate>3
```

liam.ops: Got the command. We'll run the CDN purge at 09:50 PT, start canary traffic at 10:00 PT. I'll post a short runbook to the release doc.

alex.marketing: Great. Zoe — please notch the benchmark stat into the hero and include a footnote linking the eval run. Put the eval link in the release doc.

zoe.content: Will do. Eval link: https://bench.redwood.inference/internal/superday-embed-bench-2026 (I'll include methodology snippet).

priya.prod: One last check: embargo window? Partners/press get access at +1h. Marketing publishes at 10:05 PT (short delay to confirm canary).

alex.marketing: Copy that. Timeline summarized: 09:50 PT CDN purge, 10:00 PT canary start, 10:05 PT marketing publish (post + docs + changelog), +1h partners/press access, inbound routing live immediately.

deploy-bot: NOTE: Scheduled job created: release-superday-2026 at 2026-06-12T10:00:00-07:00. Notifications will be sent to #release-war-room.

alex.marketing: Thanks all. I'll assemble the final release checklist and post in #release-war-room by EOD. If anything changes, ping here. :rocket:

zoe.content: :thumbsup: I'll drop the deck link and the short headline options in the doc in 45m.

jamie.eng: Leaving a final note — added a short code snippet and fallback model names to the changelog for transparency.

liam.ops: Running final form mapping test now, will report back in 20m.

priya.prod: Amazing. We're aligned.
